Container.Name: Arkive
Container.Overview:
Backup and disaster recovery for Unraid. Arkive finds your Docker containers and the databases behind them, dumps each database with its native tool (PostgreSQL, MariaDB/MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis), and stores the dumps together with your appdata, flash config and chosen shares as encrypted, deduplicated restic snapshots on a local disk, SFTP, Backblaze B2, S3-compatible storage, Wasabi, Google Drive or Dropbox.
It also checks that backups keep working: an overdue-backup watchdog, an optional heartbeat URL for Uptime Kuma or healthchecks.io, weekly restore drills that load recent dumps into a throwaway container, and notifications through Discord, Slack, ntfy, email and other Apprise services. A recovery kit and a printable restore plan cover the day the server is gone.
User shares, the flash config and the Docker socket are mounted read-only. Restores go to the config folder, and you copy files into place from there. After installing, open the web UI and follow the setup wizard.
Container.Requires: Arkive runs as root and has the Docker socket, so it can control Docker on this server. Keep its web UI on your LAN or behind an authenticating reverse proxy, and finish the setup wizard right after installing. After setup, save the recovery kit (Settings, Recovery kit) somewhere other than this server: without the encryption password no snapshot can be restored.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Arkive web interface and API. Don't expose it to the internet.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Arkive's database, encryption keyfile, logs, database dumps and restores.

Config.Name: User Shares
Config.Description: Your user shares, read-only. Arkive reads appdata and the shares you choose to back up, and finds SQLite databases in app folders through this path.

Config.Name: Flash Drive
Config.Description: Unraid flash drive config, read-only, for flash backups.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Used to discover containers and run database dump tools inside them. Read-only doesn't limit Docker API calls: whoever controls Arkive controls Docker.

Config.Name: Local Backups
Config.Description: Read-write folder for a local storage target (the setup wizard suggests /mnt/user/backups). Remove this path if you only use remote targets. A local target doesn't protect against losing the server, so add an off-site target too.

Config.Name: Restic Cache
Config.Description: restic metadata cache. Speeds up backups to remote targets; safe to delete.
